annotations.title: Link to watch a market for rule changes

description: Use when the user wants to be told, alerted or notified when a Polymarket, Polymarket US or Kalshi market's rules, resolution source, end date or title change, or wants to watch, follow or track a market for rule edits. Returns a RulesWatch link that opens with that market ready to watch, what an alert covers, and the plan limits. It does not create a watch or change anything: the user opens the link and presses Watch. Pass the market's link as id, or venue and id from search_markets.

id.description: The market: a Polymarket or Polymarket US market id (a number, like 562802), a Kalshi market ticker (like KXFEDDECISION-26DEC-H25, any case), or the market's Polymarket, Polymarket US, Kalshi or RulesWatch link as the user pasted it. With a link, venue can be left out.

venue.description: pm (or polymarket) for Polymarket, pmus for Polymarket US, kalshi for Kalshi. Can be left out when id is a link.
